description: This Java source file defines the MessageCommandResponseMappingStrategies class, which provides mapping strategies for different message command response types in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It includes methods for initializing strategy mappings and extracting feature IDs from adaptables.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponseMappingStrategies
classes.description: Provides mapping strategies for message command responses, implementing singleton pattern and strategy initialization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageCommandResponseMappingStrategies.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns the map of signal type strings to JsonifiableMapper functions.

methods.name: featureIdForMessageFrom
methods.description: Extracts the feature ID from the payload path of an adaptable, throwing JsonParseException if absent.
